resources.string: Browse booru images, GIFs and videos. Add a named profile for each board or tag collection.
Search uses booru tags: blue_hair smile requires both; -comic excludes a tag. Use underscores inside a tag. Base tags apply to every search and home category. Context and OCR are unavailable.
Konachan’s proxy serves safe posts only. Other ratings, account credentials and browser verification use the board’s direct API. A blocked route is reported without silent retries or switching.
Leave both fields empty for anonymous browsing. Credentials are encrypted in this extension and sent only to the direct board API. Danbooru account/search limits and Cloudflare blocks still apply.
Connected. The board accepted this query.
The board denied access. Check optional account details or try the other route. Cloudflare restrictions may apply; this extension does not bypass them.
The board is rate limiting requests. Wait before testing again.
Enter a source name and a valid pair of account details, or leave both account fields empty. Gelbooru requires a numeric user ID. Use All ratings for rating: overrides in base tags.
Could not reach the board. Check your connection or route, then retry.
The board or proxy returned an unsupported response. Try the other route or update the extension.
Could not complete this operation. Check your settings and try again.
Complete the board’s browser check, then tap Use verification. This does not sign in to your board account.

For browser challenges, verify on this device and test the connection again. Only Cloudflare cookies and the browser user agent are retained in this profile. Verification expires; some networks or embedded browsers may still be rejected.
No clearance cookie is available yet. Complete the browser check, or go back if this board does not require verification.
Cloudflare requires browser verification. Tap Verify with Cloudflare, complete the check, then test the connection again.
Save this profile to use it in SAO.
